net: # Source of truth for every electrical connection. One row per node.
# Pin mapping follows the RB-EMS configuration in rb-ems-go (ems-chtegt.json / ems-adc.json); check with `make rbems`.
# Rows of the same net are listed in physical daisy-chain order (the DIY wiring list follows it).
# Power nets (3V3 5V GND) are rails: every node connects to the rail.
# Net NC = deliberately unconnected pin (documents intent; not wired).

note: Pi 3V3 (switched off in STANDBY -> sensors follow the Pi)
Translator low side follows the Pi 3V3
Only the ADS1115 side of the translator uses 5 V
Extra ground in the ribbon (between MISO and the CS lines)
RB-EMS: ADS1115 + air quality on I2C0 (dtoverlay=i2c0-pi5)
GPIO20 = SPI1 MOSI (the v3.0 image labels it MISO)
GPIO19 = SPI1 MISO (the v3.0 image labels it MOSI)
GPIO8 (kernel CE0 must be released: dtoverlay=spi0-0cs)
GPIO7 (kernel CE1 must be released: dtoverlay=spi0-0cs)
ems-adc.json channel 1: rail50 (v3.0 image: fuel pressure)
No free GPIO in the RB-EMS scheme: software polls
Module default sets the address (0x76 or 0x77)
Module pulls CSB high = I2C mode
No free GPIO: rb-ems-go polls the conversion
No free GPIO: faults read from the status register (0x0F)
